releaseName: Agents use DraftLoop, and a tidier Prepare panel
summary: Any agent that speaks MCP can now work with DraftLoop, not only coding agents. Workspace settings has an Agents section: it creates an agent token with the scopes you tick and gives a ready-to-copy setup for the Claude Code plugin, Claude Code, Codex and other MCP agents (#2452, #2453). With those scopes, an agent lists your job applications, opens one, adds a job from pasted text and follows a CV run; approvals stay in DraftLoop, and routes not cleared for agents refuse agent tokens (#2452, #2454). DraftLoop installs as a Claude Code plugin from its repository, with the /log-work and /tailor-cv skills (#2455, #2465). The app says "agent" instead of "coding agent" throughout (#2467). The Prepare panel is restyled, sits after the CV folded by default, and an application with no run shows Collecting inputs (#2469). A drafted cover letter has room to finish, and a failed model answer is named (#2470). The career interview finds profile facts for a typed subject saved without any (#2448). Workflow actions are pinned to commit SHAs (#2468).
knownLimitations: Agents cannot approve or export: those stay in DraftLoop. The interviewer's question is still written in one call before it is spoken. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The screening shadow only logs. Live speech and the career interview still need DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key on staging. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
